summary: Verstappen clashes with treacherous track conditions as Austin's brutal bumps threaten to upend the championship fight, while Antonelli hunts his maiden world title with pressure mounting in the final stretch. Racing Bulls' seat uncertainty looms over Lindblad and Lawson as they battle for survival on a circuit that punishes setup compromises. Victory here could prove decisive—one mistake on the unforgiving surface could shift championship momentum decisively as the season enters its decisive phase.
